subject: Re: CIW kickoff — robust training under label noise as a shared component
body:
Status.

Library extraction done — the closed-form weight updates are now a standalone module with a keras-style wrapper; Farah's CI runs the CIFAR-10 40% symmetric-noise config as the regression test.

Benchmark validation under way (Emeka): on CIFAR-10 with 40% symmetric noise we match the published CIW numbers, and the CICW variant — using the instance weights to drive mixup — adds a further +1.8 accuracy, consistent with the paper's finding that weighted mixup gives additional gains under noise.

Risk to flag: on one internal dataset the class-weight constraint interacts badly with extreme class imbalance (weights collapse toward the head classes). Giannis is testing the label-smoothing-style relaxation the theory section suggests. If it doesn't resolve by mid-June we ship instance-weighting-only recipes for imbalanced data and document it.

Leilani
